claims: NASA's Artemis II mission officially launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026
NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission
NASA's Artemis II mission carries four astronauts around the moon
NASA's Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since 1972
NASA's Artemis II mission followed a postponement from early 2026
The Artemis II mission goal is a 10-day crewed test flight around the moon
The Artemis II launch was successful
The Artemis II crew reported minor technical issues with the toilet system
The Artemis II crew continued with the mission
Backup opportunities for the Artemis II launch were scheduled for April 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and April 30, 2026 if a launch had not occurred on April 1
